text:
mina: Quick FYI — starting RBAC role refactor rollout now. We're renaming the old `admin` -> `platform_admin` and splitting `admin` perms into `org_admin` + `infra_admin` to reduce blast radius.

alex: thx. any migration script? worried about Dedicated customers with pinned roles.

mina: yes, migration runs in two phases. Phase 1: read-only aliasing (both names accepted). Phase 2 (T+48h): strict enforcement, old `admin` removed. We'll post warnings to tenants. Need docs + SDK note.

jordan: heads-up: found access-control bug in staging where `org_admin` couldn't view KMS key policies. Possibly scope mismatch in policy mapper.

sam: @jordan can you paste the error? logs?

jordan: error snippet:
```
403 Forbidden: AccessDeniedException - kms:ListAliases on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01
policy_bound_to_role: "role:org_admin"
request_context: {principal: user:alice, source: redwood-dedicated}
```

mina: ok that's consistent with policy mapper not copying kms:listaliases -> infra_admin only. I think we mis-scoped kms permissions to infra_admin exclusively.

devex-bot: Deploy started by mina — schema/rbac-mapper v2.3.1 -> staging

alex: action item: add troubleshooting FAQ for customers who see 403 on KMS ops after migration. Also include sample IAM policy patch and SDK guidance.

mina: Draft troubleshooting steps:
1) Confirm role mapping: `GET /v1/orgs/:org_id/roles` -> look for `roleBindings` that include `org_admin`.
2) Check audit log entry for `policy_mapper` index: `policy_mapper:applied -> old_admin_alias`.
3) If KMS 403, temporary workaround: assign `infra_admin` role to the user/service account.
4) Permanent: apply migration patch to include `kms:ListAliases` and `kms:GetKeyPolicy` for `org_admin` where needed.

sam: can we include exact SDK snippet? people copy paste.

mina: yes — sample Node SDK patch example:
```
// grant infra perms during migration window
await redwood.roles.addRoleBinding({
  orgId: 'org_123',
  principal: 'user:alice',
  role: 'infra_admin',
  reason: 'temporary-kms-workaround'
});
// audit note will capture change
```

jordan: also add note for Private (VPC) customers: KMS key ARNs must be reachable from the control plane IPs. We had one case where key policy looked fine but net ACL blocked it.

ops-jen: @mina can we flag tenants with mixed old/new roles and email them? ops can run a check and create support tickets automatically.

mina: yes — ops script: `scripts/rbac/check_mixed_roles.sh` will emit CSV and create PS tickets. We'll run it after staging verification.

alex: docs update checklist (short):
- Update RBAC overview page (roles matrix)
- Add migration timeline + automated aliasing behavior
- Troubleshooting KMS 403 page w/ SDK snippets
- FAQ: "Why did my admin lose access?" explaining split + temporary mitigation

devex-bot: Note: Please submit PRs against `docs/rbac/` and tag `devex`.

sam: one more: audit logging — after migration, ensure audit logs preserve old role names for 90 days for traceability.

mina: good call. retention policy: keep `role_history` entries 90d and include `legacy_role` field for each change. Security will keep a snapshot.

sec-bot: Security alert resolved: policy_mapper race condition detected. Hotfix deployed to staging; will push to prod after 2h of smoke tests. (link: https://internal.redwood/issue/SEC-872)

jordan: smoke tests look green on staging for role mapping and KMS ops.

ops-jen: scheduling prod rollout at 0200 UTC to minimize impact. I'll post incident notifications and update status.

alex: final ask — add short FAQ entry for SDK maintainers about how role names map across versions. We should avoid hardcoding `admin` in client libs.

mina: agreed. I'll open a follow-up thread for SDK deprecations + PRs. thanks all :thumbsup:
